{{Use dmy dates|date=June 2020}}
This is a list of '''[[Bundesliga]] top scorers''' season by season.<ref>{{cite web|title=Bundesliga top kuj scorers|url=https://www.dfb.de/index.php?id=82910|publisher=dfb.de|access-date=8 October 2011}}</ref> Since 1966, a trophy sponsored by the German football magazine ''[[kicker (sports magazine)|Kicker]]'', shaped in the form of a miniature artillery piece, has been awarded to the top scorer at the end of each season. It is formally named the "Kicker-Torjägerkanone" (literally "kicker goal hunter cannon"). [[Robert Lewandowski]] holds the records for most goals in a single season, with 41 goals scored in the [[2020–21 Bundesliga|2020–21 campaign]], and most consecutive awards won, with five.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Sharma |first=Abhinav |date=2023-11-12 |title=How many goals has Robert Lewandowski scored during his career? Barcelona star's jaw-dropping stats in full |url=https://www.goal.com/en-us/lists/career-goals-robert-lewandowski-dortmund-bayern-barcelona-poland/blta1977c39928f1ed9 |access-date=2024-01-23 |website=www.goal.com |language=en-US}}</ref> Lewandowski and [[Gerd Müller]] are the record holders for the most awards won, with seven. The latest recipient of the award is [[Harry Kane]] of [[FC Bayern Munich| Bayern Munich]].
